historical_references.reference: Dharmanand was a famous Jain scholar and philosopher of the 12th century AD. He is attributed to have written the commentary on the 'Kalpa Sutra' known as 'Samayasara'. His works significantly contributed to the development of Jain philosophy.

Dharmanand was a king of the Ganga dynasty in the 10th century AD. He ruled over Bengal and Bihar and is known for his patronage of art and culture, particularly Buddhism and Jainism. He is also credited with the construction of several temples and monasteries.
